notice: SYNTHETIC AND FABRICATED. This illustrative summary reproduces only figures recorded in the private project's dated evaluation evidence, re-stated for public release. It is documentation, not a performance claim.

disclaimer: These results describe the synthetic test setup and do not predict real-world fraud-detection performance.
